title: INGOL work-item team record
description: The minimal work graph one work item declares about itself (WI014-AC02): which other work items must be integrated before this one. It is closed by construction — schema_version, work_item and depends_on and nothing else — so a weight, a label, a kind, a rank or a lane cannot smuggle scheduling or visualization semantics past the schema. Integration-queue state and order (WI014-AC03) are never written here: they are derived into .ingol/generated/ by folding every work item's team.yaml, plan.yaml and lifecycle state, so no work item can assert its own queue position. depends_on is required and may be the empty sequence: a work item with no dependencies says so explicitly rather than by omission, which is what keeps an absent file distinguishable from an empty graph.

depends_on.description: Zero or more work-item ULIDs that must fold to integrated before this work item may leave the blocked state. Entries are distinct (uniqueItems) and each is a Crockford ULID of the same shape a work-item directory carries. A work item naming itself here is rejected in Go, not by this schema: JSON Schema 2020-12 cannot compare one instance value against a sibling, so expressing that rule here would require a construct that only appears to enforce it.
